about: Pinned vectors of Q_call v1 (verity.primitives.circuits.cut 'Q_call v1', verity.primitives.circuits.partition_object, verity/primitives/circuits/PROTOCOL.md §11), checked by verity/primitives/circuits/tests/test_qcall_vectors.py; written by it with --write.  Programs are descriptor bytes (TWide_v1, TAdd64_v1 and TLo32_v1 are test primitives).  Gate indices in a Call are local (layout order, 0 = the Call's first gate); owner, committed, outputs and recomputed number the computing gates compactly (keep).
order_refusals: a gate of a Call reads itself
served: a gate that is not an integer
a key that is no Call
